tool.name: ccnv extract
tool.description: Extract binned read counts and cfDNA fragmentomics into sample Parquet
tool.command: CCNV_THREADS="\${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1}" && #if $alignment.is_of_type("cram"): ln -s '$alignment' input.cram && #if $alignment.metadata.cram_index and str($alignment.metadata.cram_index) != 'None': ln -s '$alignment.metadata.cram_index' input.cram.crai && #else: CCNV_THREADS=1 && #end if #set $align_input = "input.cram" #else: ln -s '$alignment' input.bam && #if $alignment.metadata.bam_index and str($alignment.metadata.bam_index) != 'None': ln -s '$alignment.metadata.bam_index' input.bam.bai && #else: CCNV_THREADS=1 && #end if #set $align_input = "input.bam" #end if @STAGE_OPTIONAL_FASTA@ ccnv extract '$align_input' --prefix out_sample --bin-size '$bin_size' @FASTA_ARG@ --min-mapq '$filters.min_mapq' $filters.keep_duplicates $filters.keep_secondary $filters.keep_supplementary $filters.allow_improper_pairs $all_contigs --threads "\$CCNV_THREADS" --loglevel '$loglevel'

param.name: alignment
param.label: Aligned reads (BAM or CRAM)
param.help: Coordinate-sorted BAM or CRAM alignment file. Multi-threaded tile streaming uses an attached .bai/.crai index automatically; unindexed inputs fall back to single-threaded streaming.

param.label: Bin size (bp)
param.help: Target genomic bin width in base pairs.

param.label: Minimum mapping quality
param.help: Minimum MAPQ required to retain an alignment record.

param.label: Keep improper pairs
param.help: Retain paired reads not flagged as proper pairs.

param.label: Bin all header contigs
param.help: By default only canonical chromosomes (1-22, X, Y) are binned; enable for non-human or custom assemblies.

tool.help:
**What it does**
``ccnv extract`` streams a BAM or CRAM alignment once using the compiled Rust ``ccnv._core`` scanner into a Zstandard-compressed Apache Arrow/Parquet sample sketch (``.ccnv``).
Paired-end proper pairs are assigned by their fragment dyad midpoint (``TLEN > 0``) to prevent boundary double-counting, while single-end reads are binned by 0-based ``reference_start``. Alongside per-bin counts, the output stores 24 fragment-length bands, short-fragment counts (80-150 bp), endpoint counts, fragment GC sums, and sample-level fragment size histograms and 5' 4-mer end-motif spectra.
**Inputs**
- **Aligned reads**: Coordinate-sorted BAM or CRAM (CRAM requires selecting a matching reference FASTA). - **Reference FASTA**: Optional for BAM, required for CRAM inputs.
**Outputs**
- **Sample Parquet (.ccnv)**: Compact coordinate-free sample sketch ready for ``ccnv reference`` or ``ccnv predict``.
